tools.name: workbooks_search_people
tools.description: Search CRM people (contacts) with optional filters and paging. Workbooks API: GET /crm/people.api.

tools.name: workbooks_search_organisations
tools.description: Search CRM organisations (companies) with optional filters and paging. Workbooks API: GET /crm/organisations.api.

tools.name: workbooks_search_tasks
tools.description: Search activity tasks with optional filters and paging. Workbooks API: GET /activity/tasks.api.

tools.name: workbooks_search_activities
tools.description: Search activities (calls, emails, meetings) with optional filters and paging. Workbooks API: GET /activity/activities.api.

tools.name: workbooks_get_person
tools.description: Get one CRM person by id. Workbooks API: GET /crm/people.api filtered on id.

tools.name: workbooks_get_organisation
tools.description: Get one CRM organisation by id. Workbooks API: GET /crm/organisations.api filtered on id.

tools.name: workbooks_list_record_types
tools.description: List the record types and fields this database exposes through the API, including custom fields. Call it before filtering on a non-standard field. Workbooks API: GET /metadata/types.api.
